scope_note: Mission-independent preliminary design defaults for CubeSat-class studies. Values are conservative and intended for early trades only.

sunlight_fraction.description: Typical LEO orbit-average sunlit fraction used for first-pass average power budgeting.

eclipse_fraction.description: Typical LEO orbit-average eclipse fraction (1 - sunlight_fraction). Used for battery sizing and eclipse operations.

eps_efficiency.description: End-to-end electrical power system efficiency from generation/storage to regulated payload bus (includes conversion and distribution losses).

solar_degradation_factor_eol.description: End-of-life solar array performance factor relative to beginning-of-life for typical CubeSat missions (radiation/aging/contamination).

power_margin_factor.description: Preliminary design power margin multiplier applied to average power loads to account for modeling uncertainty.

peak_power_headroom_factor.description: Additional headroom multiplier for peak loads (transients, startup, temperature effects).

Pdens_sunlit_W_per_m2.description: Effective sunlit electrical generation density used with total available solar area (net of packing, angle, temperature, and operational losses).

nominal_orbit_period_hr.description: Nominal LEO orbit period used for first-pass eclipse energy closure and battery sizing proxies.

thermal_margin_factor.description: Conservative thermal design margin for waste heat rejection capability (radiators, conductance paths).

internal_heat_fraction_default.description: Default assumption that most electrical power consumed by payload electronics becomes internal waste heat.

allowable_payload_temp_band_c.description: Generic allowable payload electronics temperature band for preliminary trades when vendor-specific limits are unknown.

mass_growth_margin.description: Early-design mass growth allowance for unmodeled items, harness, fasteners, and iteration risk.

payload_mass_fraction_max.description: Heuristic upper bound for payload fraction of total wet mass used to avoid unrealistically payload-dominated spacecraft in early trades.

volume_fill_limit.description: Maximum recommended packaging fill fraction (remaining volume reserved for structure, harness, keep-outs, access, and late changes).

payload_volume_overhead_u.description: Default integration overhead added to payload_envelope_u when estimating minimum bus size (mechanical integration, harness, keep-outs).

battery_dod_limit.description: Nominal maximum depth-of-discharge limit for routine cycling to preserve lifetime (Li-ion typical for CubeSats).

battery_round_trip_efficiency.description: Charge/discharge round-trip efficiency for battery energy budgeting (excluding EPS conversion losses).

battery_capacity_derating_factor.description: Usable capacity derating to account for temperature effects, aging, and rate capability in preliminary sizing.

storage_utilization_limit.description: Maximum recommended fraction of onboard storage to plan to use (reserves space for filesystem overhead, retries, and contingencies).

daily_data_contingency_margin.description: Margin applied to estimated daily generated data to cover operational variability, retransmissions, and scheduling inefficiency.

onboard_storage_days_default.description: Default onboard storage buffering days used for preliminary sizing when payload onboard_storage_days is null/unknown.

downlink_efficiency_factor.description: Effective throughput factor applied to nominal link rate to account for protocol overhead, coding, pointing losses, and non-ideal pass geometry.

nominal_contact_minutes_per_day.description: Typical single-ground-station total daily contact time assumption for preliminary scheduling (varies strongly with orbit and station network).

usable_contact_fraction.description: Fraction of scheduled contact time expected to be usable for downlink after acquisition, commanding, and dropouts.

downlink_availability_target.description: Target probability that the spacecraft achieves required daily downlink volume (represents early-requirement reliability level).

integration_risk_to_margin_map.description: Default mapping from qualitative integration_risk to a sizing margin multiplier (applies to mass/power/data if the solver chooses).

single_string_architecture_default.description: Assume single-string (non-redundant) architecture by default for CubeSat-class early trades unless mission requires redundancy.

design_maturity_factor_default.description: Generic design maturity factor used to down-weight aggressive assumptions in early trades (1.0 = mature/flight-proven, lower = less certain).
